digest.component_or_area: CLI command dispatcher and verb registration
propositions: Three CLI verb commands are renamed to nest under a bridge noun: `bridge-fsck` becomes `rebar bridge fsck`, `bridge-probe` becomes `rebar bridge check-access`, and `jira-onboard` becomes `rebar bridge setup`
Old verb spellings remain functional as compatibility entrypoints that route through identical implementation paths without behavioral changes
All in-tree consumers including CLI dispatch arms, help text, schemas, tests, scripts, workflows, and documentation must be migrated to new spellings while preserving backward compatibility
The bridge-fsck schema JSON both its $id and description must be updated to reflect the new canonical verb name
Behavioral parity tests must exercise both old and new spellings for success cases, failure cases, options/arguments, output schemas, and exit codes
